result.summary: Verdict FINDINGS at target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895. Read-only review of the terminal dashboard (src/cli/tui.ts, overview.ts, client.ts, cli.ts dashboard path): 6 findings, 1 HIGH / 2 MEDIUM / 3 LOW. HIGH: tui.ts:56 refresh() overwrites data with client.overview() (client.ts:88 returns the raw endpoint), discarding the scrub applied once at cli.ts:160, so renderOverview (overview.ts:156) reprints a credential-bearing MCP URL in clear text from the first 5s poll - reproduced with a fake client. MEDIUM: renderOverview never calls safeTerminalText; alt screen/hidden cursor restored only from the keypress quit path (tui.ts:136). LOW: in-flight poll snapshot overwrites a completed control action (destroyed shown as running); destroy confirmation is never re-validated against current state; Ctrl-D arms the destroy confirmation. Local fakes only. Artifacts: .swarmforge/artifacts/review.md, findings.json.
result.details:
Scope: terminal dashboard input/render/lifecycle/control confirmations, race handling, untrusted terminal control characters. Read-only; disposable detached clone at /tmp/opencode/rev-42/checkout, git rev-parse HEAD = d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895. /workspace/repo left at assigned baseline 5672ead, clean and untouched.

F1 HIGH src/cli/tui.ts:56 (with client.ts:88, cli.ts:160, overview.ts:156/212). cli.ts:160 scrubs data.url once; the first poll refresh or the 'r' key replaces the whole data object with client.overview(), whose url is the raw connectSwarmForge endpoint. resolveClientSettings validates only the scheme (settings/load.ts:871-891) so userinfo/query credentials are accepted and are deliberately scrubbed elsewhere (cli.ts:157-159; tests/settings.test.ts:949). Reproduced with a fake client (probe g2.ts): frame1 'MCP  https://[REDACTED]@mcp.example/mcp?token=[REDACTED] post-refresh 'MCP  https://[REDACTED]@mcp.example/mcp?token=[REDACTED] redrawn every second.

F2 MEDIUM src/cli/overview.ts:212. The overview body is clipped but never passed through safeTerminalText (contrast overview.ts:274 and tui.ts:48); raw ESC/OSC survives (probes D/H). Reachability honestly bounded: idSchema (domain.ts:24-28), enum state and WHATWG URL parsing (verified to reject raw control bytes) block a compliant server, so this is defense-in-depth plus a real gap for a hostile/compromised endpoint accepted via --url.

F3 MEDIUM src/cli/tui.ts:136. Alt screen + hidden cursor + raw mode entered at tui.ts:121; restore bytes exist only in stop(), reachable only from the keypress handler. The await at tui.ts:123 has no try/finally and no SIGTERM/SIGHUP/exit handlers (probe E: listener counts 0 during a session). SIGTERM or a stdout EPIPE in the 1s redraw leaves the terminal in the alternate screen with a hidden cursor.

F4 LOW src/cli/tui.ts:60/63/65/107. A poll refresh that passes the !busy check and then blocks in client.worker(id) completes after control() (whose refresh() call no-ops while refreshing=true) and overwrites detail with the pre-action snapshot: probe A shows the final frame rendering RUNNING and re-offering 'p pause' after a confirmed destroy.

F5 LOW src/cli/tui.ts:144. The confirmation branch dispatches control('destroy') without the availableActions(state) check used at tui.ts:177 and confirmation is never invalidated by refresh; probe C2 shows 5 frames still prompting to destroy an already-destroyed worker and y dispatching destroy.

F6 LOW src/cli/tui.ts:184. key.name==='d' is matched without key.ctrl, and tui.ts:140 special-cases only ctrl+c; readline reports Ctrl-D as {name:'d',ctrl:true} (verified), and probe ctrld2 confirms Ctrl-D arms the destroy confirmation, whose prompt names no worker.

Probes and disposable files live only in /tmp/opencode/rev-42/probe; no real MCP server, provider, VM or network was contacted. No credential or secret file was read; probe values are synthetic placeholders. Full suite, typecheck/compile and smoke were out of scope and not run.

tests.command: bun test tests/overview.test.ts -> 10 pass, 0 fail, exit 0 (bun 1.3.14, no third-party modules needed); bun test tests/cli.test.ts -> 0 pass, 1 fail, exit 1 (Cannot find module '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/index.js'; disposable clone has no node_modules and Bun 1.3.14 cannot read lockfileVersion 2, so dependencies were not installed - reported, not retried); probes bun run tui-probe.ts, url-probe.ts, g2.ts, misc.ts, ctrld.ts, ctrld2.ts all exit 0.
tests.summary: Ran only the dashboard-relevant test file plus six local fake-client probes. tests/overview.test.ts passes (10/10). tests/cli.test.ts could not execute for missing dependencies, so tests.passed is false and the full suite was intentionally not run.

warnings: bun test tests/cli.test.ts fails with exit 1 (Cannot find module '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/index.js') because the disposable clone has no node_modules and the snapshot Bun 1.3.14 cannot read lockfileVersion 2; dependencies were deliberately not installed.
Interactive TTY behaviours (alt-screen entry, cursor visibility, line wrapping) were reasoned from the emitted byte stream, not observed in a terminal emulator.
F2's reachable vector is narrow against a compliant SwarmForge server (idSchema, enum state, WHATWG URL parsing) and is reported as defense-in-depth rather than a live injection.

Quitting with q while a control request is in flight lets cli.ts close the MCP transport; the server may still complete the already-sent action (inherent HTTP at-most-once ambiguity), noted but not raised as a separate finding.
Bun 1.4.2 was not installed: no probe needed it, since src/cli/tui.ts and src/cli/overview.ts have no third-party runtime imports; the lockfile was never rewritten.
result.followup_reason: F1 HIGH is an actionable credential-exposure defect: src/cli/tui.ts:56 discards the scrub applied at src/cli.ts:160 and reprints the raw MCP endpoint (src/cli/client.ts:88 -> src/cli/overview.ts:156) on every refresh. F2/F3 are actionable (overview lacks safeTerminalText; terminal restore is only on the keypress path). F4/F5/F6 are low-severity but concrete: stale-snapshot overwrite after a control action, un-revalidated destroy confirmation, and Ctrl-D arming the destroy prompt. Report and findings JSON at /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md and findings.json; logs at /workspace/.swarmforge/logs.
